Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent full-body task-state character for DeepSeek desktop skin.
Input images: the supplied existing illustration is identity, costume and rendering reference, not a pose constraint.
Keep exactly the elegant young adult anime woman from the reference: long cobalt blue hair, braided side bun, blue whale-tail hairpin, blue eyes, white frilled maid headband, modest classic navy blue and white maid dress, white apron, white tights and blue Mary Jane heels. Normal mature anime proportions, NOT chibi. Crisp polished anime illustration, same gentle face and finely rendered white frills. Face and body angled toward SCREEN LEFT, never toward screen right.
Output one isolated character with action props only, 1024 x 1536 portrait, genuine transparent alpha background. Full body including shoes and props entirely in frame with small margins. No scene rectangle, no atmospheric glow, no vignette, no gradient background, no shadows covering the transparent canvas. No words, letters, numbers, logo or watermark. No other characters.
New action: standing and organizing a compact elegant silver-white and blue bookshelf. The narrow waist-to-shoulder-height bookshelf stands to her SCREEN LEFT with three shelves and neat rows of blue and cream books. She turns slightly left, with one hand carefully sliding a blue book upright into a row at chest height and the other hand holding two additional books against her waist. Face visible above the books, calm satisfied concentration. Bookshelf and character form one balanced compact silhouette, fill the portrait, no giant empty space. Use natural graceful anatomy and plausible hands. This must clearly depict putting books away rather than merely reading.
assets.inspection: Accepted after visual inspection: coherent identity, recognizable action, full body and props within frame. No legible text or extra people.
assets.method: built-in image_gen.imagegen; original output bytes copied without pixel editing
